casual1.scene: Harbor roof tiles descend toward tiny dock lights beneath a clear midnight sky; a slim telescope stands beside a stone parapet.
casual1.outfit: A fully lined heritage-patterned one-piece swimsuit with matching woven trim, a plunging neckline and a low open back, in warm rust and cream.

why.scene: Place-led note adds harbor lights, sky and telescope support without changing stargazing.
why.outfit: Keeps the heritage swimsuit and adds the planned plunge and open-back construction.

era.en: inside the Pokémon world, as if she simply lives there

place.en: a rooftop terrace above a Pokémon-world harbor town

act.en: adjusting a small telescope to look at the stars

ofam.en: modern swimwear, fully lined and secure during movement

casual2.scene: A coil of twine, a grooming brush and metal scoops cover the shop counter beneath amber closing-time lamps.
casual2.outfit: Short work overalls over a fitted asymmetric tank top with one shoulder strap resting off the shoulder, and rubber boots; the overall shorts end high on the thighs.

why.scene: Detail-led note specifies which shop tools are being put away and the closing-time light.
why.outfit: The selected overalls and tank are shortened and asymmetric to express the planned off-shoulder neckline and mini length.

era.en: inside the Pokémon world, as if she simply lives there

act.en: tidying her tools and supplies at the end of a shift

casual3.scene: Bright contest spotlights sweep beyond the spectator seats; soft confetti colors reflect from the stage.
casual3.outfit: A playful cropped one-shoulder uniform-inspired costume with crisp lapels and decorative epaulettes, a short pleated skirt and a bare waist, in ivory and forest green.

why.scene: Light-led note adds contest spotlights and distant confetti without changing seated applause.
why.outfit: Keeps the chosen event uniform while revealing one shoulder and the midriff as planned.
